name: 3D 22. shell dream cature
shortDescription: A one-off three-dimensional .22 shell dream catcher with a center stone, originally hung from my father’s rear-view mirror.
description: This is a three-dimensional .22 shell dream catcher made at my standard one-paperclip size, using two forms together to create the 3D shape. Unlike the more repeatable dream-catcher designs, I only made one of this version.
A stone sits in the center of the piece. My father originally hung it from his rear-view mirror, and it later ended up displayed in my mother's kitchen.
